angularDiameterSource: Computed here from the record's radius and distance: 2 x 444,552 km at 32.57 pc = 0.18 mas. No interferometric diameter of this star is used.
distanceSource: Gaia DR3 parallax 30.7027 +/- 0.0181 mas (same row, RUWE 0.93): 32.57 pc, no zero-point correction
radiusSource: Radius 0.639 +/- 0.034 solar radii from Filomeno et al. 2026, the stellar radius of the default parameter set of TOI-5734 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2026A&A...708A..90F/abstract): 444,552 km at 695,700 km per solar radius. Mass 0.724 +/- 0.009 solar masses from Filomeno et al. 2026, the stellar mass of the default parameter set of TOI-5734 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2026A&A...708A..90F/abstract); GM is that mass times the JPL solar GM. Temperature 4750 +/- 100 K from Filomeno et al. 2026, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of TOI-5734 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2026A&A...708A..90F/abstract). presentationUp: the display axis is a sky-plane convention; the spin axis's position angle on the sky is not measured.
effectiveTemperatureSource: Filomeno et al. 2026, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of TOI-5734 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2026A&A...708A..90F/abstract)
surfaceGravitySource: log g from the mass and radius in packages/astronomy/data/bodies/toi-5734.json (sources in its physicalNotes), log10(GM/R^2) in cgs: 4.687, rounded to two decimals
spectralTypeSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of TOI-5734 (pscomppars): spectral type K3-K4 V, from Filomeno et al. 2026 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2026A&A...708A..90F/abstract)
objectTypeSource: SIMBAD, BD+37 1713: main object type *, Star
metallicitySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of TOI-5734 (pscomppars): [Fe/H] -0.13 dex, from Filomeno et al. 2026 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2026A&A...708A..90F/abstract)
luminositySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of TOI-5734 (pscomppars): log10 of the luminosity in solar units -0.74232, from Filomeno et al. 2026 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2026A&A...708A..90F/abstract)
ageSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of TOI-5734 (pscomppars): age 0.5 Gyr, from Filomeno et al. 2026 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2026A&A...708A..90F/abstract)
rotationPeriodSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of TOI-5734 (pscomppars): rotation period 11.09 d, from Filomeno et al. 2026 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2026A&A...708A..90F/abstract)
projectedRotationSpeedSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of TOI-5734 (pscomppars): projected rotation speed 2.9 km/s, from Filomeno et al. 2026 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2026A&A...708A..90F/abstract)
spinInclinationSource: Computed here from this record's rotation period, projected rotation speed and radius (0.639 solar radii): sin i = v sin i × P / (2πR) = 0.995. Not a measurement of the axis: the three numbers come from different papers.

shape.qualification: A sphere at the published radius, colored from a blackbody at the star's published temperature (photometry/stellar-color.json); no image of the photosphere exists.
